definitions.explanation: General term for tools used for writing, including pens, pencils, mechanical pencils, and markers. Frequently seen in exam instructions and school supply lists.

examples.japanese: {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please bring your own writing utensils.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{消|け}しゴム→消しゴム：00716_keshigomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Writing utensils and an eraser are needed for the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}こう→書く：00477_kaku⟧とした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I tried to write my name at the reception desk, but I had forgotten my writing utensils.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal compound noun formed from ⟦{筆記|ひっき}→筆記：00101_hikki⟧ (writing) + ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧ (tools, equipment). Very common in official instructions such as exam guidelines, seminar notices, and school supply lists. In casual speech, people are more likely to say ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧ or ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧ for specific items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧ (to bring writing utensils)
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧ (a complete set of writing utensils)
- {筆記用具|ひっきようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to forget one's writing utensils)
